title: Day 30 簿記・会計 — 不適切会計、12年ぶりの低水準
description: In fiscal 2025, only 35 listed companies in Japan disclosed improper accounting. That number fell 47.7 percent from the year before. It was the lowest total in 12 years. Of these cases, seven involved actual fraud. In the past, large companies with foreign subsidiaries often caused these problems. This year, however, cases on the Growth market increased instead. The Growth market lists many small, newer companies. So accounting problems are now shifting toward younger firms. This trend surprised many auditors and investors. They had expected fraud to keep rising, not falling.
